brainlife.desc: Diffusion-weighted MRI series (4D NIfTI) with FSL-style bvecs and bvals; raw or preprocessed, told apart by tags.
brainlife.name: neuro/dwi

original.desc: Diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance data (dMRI), saved in NIfTI-1 format.

brainlife.readme:
Used brainlife/validator-neuro-dwi for validator

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.dwi.json

files.desc: Gradient directions, FSL format (3 rows, one column per volume).
Single-band reference for one or more multi-band dwi images.
JSON sidecar of the single-band reference.

identifying_risks: JSON metadata may hold acquisition dates, institution or device serials
Low-resolution b0 volumes include the head outline
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level neurodata linkable through a code; no recognisable face at typical resolution.
sharing_cautions: Strip acquisition dates and device identifiers from metadata before sharing
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if metadata keeps acquisition dates or device serials
